name: JAX Seldon
author: JohnAndrewsX
description: The memory of your Omarchy machine, for you and your agents: ledger, journal, cases, drift and the Prime Radiant in one desk.

barWidget.description: Active cases and crises at a glance

schema.label: Capture interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the engine captures system changes while the shell runs.

schema.label: Active cases limit
schema.description: The Work tab shows active cases against this limit ("2 / 3 active"); it warns, it does not block.

schema.label: Changes counted in the bar
schema.description: crisis: changes that can affect boot, login or the shell and have no case. all: every change without a case. none: no count. The bar turns to the error colour on a crisis in every mode.

schema.label: Desk width (% of the screen)
schema.description: How wide the Seldon desk opens, in per cent of the screen's width; never narrower than 960 px unless the screen is. Also set in the desk under Settings › Appearance.

schema.label: Desk sidebar
schema.description: open: section names and counts. collapsed: icons only. On a desk narrower than 960 px the sidebar always shows icons only.
